title: Volatility
description: How much the price has been moving in the last minute, from one-second returns. The fastest read on whether things are heating up.

volatility_bps_15s.label: Volatility 15s
volatility_bps_15s.description: The spread of one-second returns over the last fifteen seconds, in basis points. Bigger means the price is swinging more right now.

volatility_bps_60s.label: Volatility 60s
volatility_bps_60s.description: The spread of one-second returns over the last minute, in basis points. The baseline the fifteen-second read is compared with.

regime.label: Volatility regime
regime.description: Rising when the last fifteen seconds are hotter than the minute, falling when calmer, steady in between. Rising volatility widens the range of likely closes.
